name: ai-trust-boundary
title: AI-extracted price trust boundary — spec + optional allow-list
description: Document in backend spec that AI-extracted prices are UNTRUSTED (data-integrity, prompt-injection surface) and must never be the authoritative price in financial logic; add an optional ARGUS_AI_EXTRACT_DOMAIN_ALLOWLIST (default empty = no restriction, behavior unchanged) so operators can restrict the AI stage to trusted retailer domains. Schema-boundary invariant covered by a regression test. Finding #6.
creator: Howard Ju
